recipes.title: THE REVERSE-ENGINEERED SHOT
recipes.note: Harvested 2026-10-02 from Mythos-Video-Analyzer (his cinematography app): the reverse-engineer lane as a recipe — describe a shot's camera, lens, light and composition the way its analyzer would, and the frame renders to match. The analyzer's ten suggestion prompts (camera movement, lens and settings, scene breakdown, narrative, reverse-engineer, each for still and moving image) are the slot questions.

subject.default: a beautiful woman in an ornate sheer dress, commanding the frame
subject.note: who and what is in the shot

shot.default: medium close-up, eye-level, shallow depth of field, rule of thirds
shot.note: framing, angle, movement: close-up, tracking shot, push-in, establishing shot

lens.default: 85mm portrait lens, wide aperture, creamy bokeh

lighting.default: golden key light with soft fill, warm color grade, cinematic contrast
lighting.note: key ratios, color temperature, grading palette

style.default: photoreal cinematic film still, ultra-detailed skin, 8k, sharp focus
